overview_description.description:
PieRide is a technology platform that offers monthly subscription transportation service for daily commuters. It sends cars with trained drivers to pick clients up every morning, drive them to work or university, and back home. By utilizing technology and shared consumption model, PieRide matches clients with individuals in their work or school community.

PieRide is offering a solution that is aimed at solving the commuting difficulties prevalent in Cairo, Egypt. The platform was launched in 2013 by Karim Mansi.
